risks.risk: Shutter count may be higher than claimed, affecting value and buyer confidence.
risks.proof: A clear screenshot/photo of shutter count from the camera menu or a reputable shutter-count report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if shutter count is unknown/high (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Lens condition cannot be verified because no lens is shown; fungus/scratches could exist.
risks.proof: Clear lens photos (front and rear element close-ups) under light to check fungus/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if lens condition is not confirmed (worst case: treat as potentially needing cleaning or having minor issues).

risks.risk: Included accessories (2 batteries, charger, Godox trigger) may be missing, non-original, or not as described.
risks.proof: Lay out and photograph all included items with labels visible (battery model/brand, charger, and Godox trigger model).
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body only (worst case: accessories not confirmed).

risks.risk: Functional condition (AF, shutter actuation, LCD, ports, buttons) is not verifiable from still photos.
risks.proof: Short test video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a target, take a photo, and playback on LCD; quick check of ports/SD slot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/unknown working condition (worst case).

proof_requests: Send a shutter count screenshot/photo (or a shutter-count report) showing the number.
Send lens photos (front + rear element close-ups) showing no fungus/scratches.
Photograph all included items laid out: both batteries, charger, and the Godox trigger (labels visible).
Send a 30–60 second working test video (AF + shutter + playback).
response.reason: Seller’s “tested yesterday” statement is not proof without a shutter-count readout, lens photos, and accessory photos/videos. The current images still only confirm the camera body identity, not the key value drivers.
